title: Smear
description: A twenty-line poem in small white Arial on black that keeps re-setting itself: every few seconds a wave runs down the block and each word slides between a tight setting and wide justified gaps, leaving a soft photographic streak with a faint colour fringe and a stutter of copies. Drag across it to smear words by hand, or hold to scatter the block and let it set again.
intent: The lyric-edit motion smear as a living material: one block that breathes between two settings on its own, with sub-frame motion blur and chromatic softness on everything that moves.
sources: herb reference board: cfcf1930 gif (poem on black with stuttered horizontal motion-smear settling into a block)
